narrator.name: Narrator
narrator.note: The evangelist; sober, urgent storytelling, grave through the Passion.

jesus.name: Jesus
jesus.note: The Lord; authoritative and prophetic in ch. 13, sorrowful yet resolute in the Passion, commanding after the Resurrection.

women-at-tomb.name: The women at the tomb
women-at-tomb.note: Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome; anxious, talking among themselves.

angel-at-tomb.name: The young man in white
angel-at-tomb.note: The angel seated in the sepulchre; calm, reassuring, announcing the Resurrection.

1.t: And when the sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary, the mother of James and Salome, bought sweet spices, that coming, they might anoint Jesus.

2.t: And very early in the morning, the first day of the week, they come to the sepulchre, the sun being now risen.

3.t: And they said one to another:
Who shall roll us back the stone from the door of the sepulchre?

4.t: And looking, they saw the stone rolled back. For it was very great.

5.t: And entering into the sepulchre, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, clothed with a white robe: and they were astonished.

6.t: Be not affrighted; you seek Jesus, of Nazareth, who was crucified: he is risen, he is not here: behold the place where they laid him.

7.t: But go tell his disciples, and Peter, that he goeth before you into Galilee: there you shall see him, as he told you.

8.t: But they going out, fled from the sepulchre: for a trembling and fear had seized them: and they said nothing to any man: for they were afraid.

9.t: But he rising early the first day of the week, appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had cast seven devils.

10.t: She went, and told them that had been with him, who were mourning and weeping.

11.t: And they hearing that he was alive, and had been seen by her, did not believe.

12.t: And after that he appeared in another form to two of them walking, as they were going into the country.

13.t: And they going, told it to the rest: neither did they believe them.

14.t: At length he appeared to the eleven, as they were at table: and he upbraided them with their incredulity and hardness of heart; because they did not believe them who had seen him after he was risen again.

15.t: Go ye into the whole world, and preach the gospel to every creature.

16.t: He that believeth, and is baptized, shall be saved: but he that believeth not, shall be condemned.

17.t: And these signs shall follow them that believe: In my name they shall cast out devils: they shall speak with new tongues:

18.t: They shall take up serpents: and if they shall drink any deadly thing, it shall not hurt them: they shall lay their hands upon the sick, and they shall recover.

19.t: And the Lord Jesus, after he had spoken to them, was taken up into heaven, and sitteth on the right hand of God.

20.t: But they going forth, preached every where: the Lord co-operating with them, and confirming the word, with signs, that followed.
